title: Successful Login with Valid Credentials
preconditions: User is registered with email 'user@example.com' and password 'Password123!'. User is on the login page.
expected_result: The user is successfully logged in and redirected to the dashboard.

title: Login Attempt with Invalid Password
preconditions: User is registered with email 'user@example.com'. User is on the login page.
expected_result: An error message indicating invalid credentials is displayed, and the user remains on the login page.

title: Login Attempt with Empty Email Field
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: A validation warning is displayed indicating that the email field is required.

title: Login Attempt with Empty Password Field
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: A validation warning is displayed indicating that the password field is required.

title: Login Attempt with Both Fields Empty
preconditions: User is on the login page.
expected_result: Validation warnings are displayed for both the email and password fields.

title: Account Lockout after Three Failed Login Attempts
preconditions: User is registered with email 'user@example.com'. User is on the login page.
steps: Enter 'user@example.com' and incorrect password 'Wrong1', then click 'Login'.
Enter 'user@example.com' and incorrect password 'Wrong2', then click 'Login'.
Enter 'user@example.com' and incorrect password 'Wrong3', then click 'Login'.
expected_result: After the third failed attempt, the account is locked, and an error message is displayed informing the user that their account is locked.

title: Login Attempt with Valid Credentials on Locked Account
preconditions: User account for 'user@example.com' is locked due to 3 failed attempts.
steps: Enter the correct password 'Password123!' in the password field.
expected_result: Login is blocked, the user is not redirected to the dashboard, and an account locked error message is displayed.
